title: Tertiate
summary: TER'TIATE, verb transitive [Latin tertius, third; tertio, to do every third day.] 1. To do any thing the third time. 2. To examine the thickness of the metal at the muzzle of a gun; or in general, to

inlines.v: TER'TIATE, verb transitive [Latin tertius, third; tertio, to do every third day.] 1. To do any thing the third time. 2. To examine the thickness of the metal at the muzzle of a gun; or in general, to examine the thickness to ascertain the strength of ordnance.
